name: 壳乙螺
evolution: 甜田螺 Lv.32 → 壳乙螺 → 卡洛儿 Lv.44
description: 生活在螺壳里，似乎对壳外面的世界不太关心，多数时间都躲在壳内睡觉，对食物的香味比较敏感，可以用食物引诱出来。
descriptionEn: Living inside its shell, it seems unconcerned with the world outside, sleeping hidden within the shell most of the time. Sensitive to the smell of food, it can be lured out with food.

skills.name: 泡沫幻影
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; responds to attack: self disengages.

skills.name: 甜心续航
skills.description: 自己和敌方获得萌化：回复40%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Self and enemy gain Fairy-ization: recover 40% HP.

skills.name: 泡沫
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 肥皂泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 潮涌
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 水环
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：自己获得全技能能耗-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 60%; responds to attack: self gains all-skill energy cost -2.

skills.name: 砂糖弹球
skills.description: 造成物伤，双方体重差越大，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the greater the weight difference between the two sides, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 落雨
skills.description: 将天气改为雨天，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes weather to Rain, lasting 8 turns.

skills.name: 爆米花爆破
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 捧杀
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：敌方获得1层萌化。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 90%; responds to attack: enemy gains 1 Fairy-ization.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels own debuffs; own buffs doubled.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; for each Fairy-ization on all carried spirits of both sides, this skill's combo count +1.

skills.name: 水刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本技能能耗永久-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; responds to status: this skill's energy cost permanently -3.
